content: Abhishek Mandloi is a Senior Backend & Big Data Engineer with 4+ years of experience based in Indore, Madhya Pradesh, India. Email: abhimandloi111@gmail.com | LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/abhishek-mandloi-8412ba1b2.

About Me Narrative: I’m Abhishek Mandloi, a Senior Software Engineer with 4+ years of experience building scalable backend systems using Java, Spring Boot, and Big Data technologies. At Impetus Technologies, I work on Metatrail, a large-scale social media data platform processing ~650M records daily using Kafka, Gathr, HBase, and HDFS/YARN. I also develop Java-based services for high-performance data retrieval, achieving a 60% improvement in performance. I’m passionate about Generative AI and have built a RAG-based chatbot that reduced call-center query resolution time by 70%. I’m also experienced with Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins, and modern AI-assisted development tools. I’m currently exploring opportunities to build high-scale, reliable systems while continuing to grow at the intersection of backend engineering, distributed systems, and Generative AI.

Professional Summary: Results-driven Backend Software Engineer with 4+ years of experience in Java, Spring Boot, and Big Data engineering, specializing in real-time data pipeline development for high-volume social media data streams. Proven track record of building and deploying scalable pipelines on the Gathr platform within HDFS/YARN cluster environments, with strong hands-on expertise in Apache Kafka for stream processing and HBase for NoSQL storage. Experienced with DevOps practices (Jenkins, Docker, Kubernetes) and Generative AI application development, including a production RAG-based chatbot for call center automation. Adept at owning services end-to-end in fast-paced Agile environments, from design through production support.

Career Journey: Abhishek joined Impetus Technologies (India) Pvt. Ltd. as a fresher in March 2022 and rapidly grew into a Senior Software Engineer role (March 2022 – Present), solving large-scale Big Data and backend engineering problems.

Key Project - Metatrail Pipeline (Java, J2EE, Spring Boot, Hadoop, HBase, Gathr, Klera, Kafka): Researched and delivered optimum solutions for a large-scale social media Big Data stream processing and storage system. Key achievements: 1) Engineered production-grade data pipeline on Gathr processing ~650 million social media records per day for transformation and analysis. 2) Owned end-to-end delivery of a Java-based business service for HBase data retrieval, improving data retrieval performance by 60%. 3) Validated and deployed data pipelines and services into production through rigorous testing with minimal post-deployment issues. 4) Diagnosed and resolved critical bugs and performance bottlenecks across pipelines and services.

Key Project - RAG-based Call Center Chatbot (AWS, RAG, Generative AI, Google Gemini, GitHub Copilot): Designed and built a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) chatbot on AWS to automate FAQ handling for call center support, significantly reducing manual agent effort. Key achievements: 1) Designed and built the RAG chatbot end-to-end, reducing average query resolution time by 70%. 2) Leveraged Google Gemini and GitHub Copilot throughout development to accelerate development cycles and improve solution design and code quality.

Awards & Recognition at Impetus Technologies: 1) Star of the Month Award — Received this recognition multiple times for consistent high performance and contribution to project goals. 2) Excellence Award (Transformational Performance Award) — Awarded in recognition of transformational impact and outstanding performance in project delivery.
Programming & Big Data Skills: Core Java, J2EE, Spring Boot, Apache Kafka, HDFS, YARN, Gathr Platform, Apache Spark.
Tools, IDEs & Version Control: Klera, Gathr, WinSCP, Offset Explorer, IntelliJ IDEA, Windsurf, Git, SVN.
DevOps & Methodology: Jenkins, Docker, Kubernetes, Agile / Scrum Methodology.
AI Tools & Frameworks: Google Gemini, GitHub Copilot, AWS AI Services, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).

Education Details: 1) Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech) in Computer Science from Sage University, Indore (2018–2022). 2) 12th Standard from Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalaya, Indore (2017–2018). 3) 10th Standard from Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalaya, Indore (2015–2016).

Hobbies & Interests: Abhishek enjoys exploring emerging AI tools (Google Gemini, GitHub Copilot), experimenting with new software architectures, learning modern cloud technologies, and continuous self-improvement in software engineering.
